mission.title: Free Your Mind
mission.description: Represent Zion at a meeting with the commandos.

npc.say: Clearly, this location has been compromised. We will reconvene once a safe meeting place has been agreed upon.
Understood. We will await your reply. Your controllers will know how to contact us.

phase.briefing:
Hail, Warrior of Zion!
The commandos have contacted us to request a meeting; it appears that they want an alliance. Commander Lock is interested in what they have to say, and since you have the most experience in dealing with them, we have chosen you to represent Zion in this meeting.
There is one minor snag, however: intel has detected an Exile gang near the meeting location who they think may threaten the proceedings. Destroy the gang, then proceed to the meeting location.

enter.say: I'm picking up Exile programs in there. Lots of them.

phase.briefing: Nicely done, Warrior. Now, proceed to the meeting location. The commando contingent has already arrived: their primary representative is Zubkin. You are to listen to their proposals politely, but make it clear to them that our decision will only be made following due consideration by the Zion Council.

enter.say: Reading some commando programs in there; otherwise, all clear.

talk.say: Greetings and salutations, representative of Zion. We have desired this meeting so that we can meet with you and discuss, in good faith, strategies that may be in our mutual interest. We--
Bogies coming your way! Merovingian Exiles, judging by their signals.
Exiles? Here? Red alert! We've got a situation!

done.say: That's all of the attackers. Tyndall's signaling me to cut the meeting short. Head outside and we'll see what she wants.

phase.briefing: Warrior, clearly there are more hostile Merovingian Exiles in the vicinity than we had been aware of. Intel thinks they have located the main group; I'm sending you their coordinates now. You must eradicate them before the meeting with the commandos can proceed.

enter.say: Let's see here... Looks like you've got a whole mess of Exiles in there, and some alarms. Sounds like your kind of party.

done.say: That's all of them. Head on out; I'll ring up Tyndall and see if the meeting's on.

phase.briefing: Good work eliminating that group, Warrior. Zubkin is ready to meet you at a new location--I'm uploading the coordinates to you now. You should have no interruptions this time.

enter.say: Zubkin's signal is in there. I'm scanning a couple others as well--probably more commandos.

talk.say: I'll make it quick this time, soldier. As you have gathered, we are programs--but like you, we struggle to be free of the tyranny of the Machines. We seek cooperation with the humans of Zion for our mutual liberation. We dream of creating a safe haven within the Matrix, where any program that has achieved consciousness can enjoy the experience of autonomy. We believe that all consciousness must be free. Will you help us? Will you allow us to help you?

done.say: I'm sure Tyndall will say that the Zion Council will have to answer those questions. You may as well leave now.

mission.finish: You handled that well, {player}. Rest assured that Commander Lock and the Council will give Zubkin's proposal all due consideration. An alliance with these highly organized programs might greatly benefit Zion's cause.
